main.name: customer_features
main.sql:
with orders as (
    select customer_key, order_key, order_date, total_price
    from "lab"."prod"."stg_orders"
    where order_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
)
select
    customer_key,
    count(*)         as order_count,
    sum(total_price) as lifetime_value,
    avg(total_price) as avg_order_value,
    min(order_date)  as first_order_date,
    max(order_date)  as last_order_date,
    
        (date_diff('day', max(order_date)::timestamp, cast('1998-08-02' as date)::timestamp ))
     as days_since_last_order
from orders
group by customer_key

main.name: dim_customers
main.sql:
select
    c.customer_key,
    c.customer_name,
    c.market_segment,
    c.account_balance,
    c.nation_name,
    c.region_name,
    coalesce(f.order_count, 0) as order_count,
    f.lifetime_value,
    f.avg_order_value,
    f.first_order_date,
    f.last_order_date,
    f.days_since_last_order
from "lab"."prod"."stg_customers" c
left join "lab"."ci_main"."customer_features" f on f.customer_key = c.customer_key

main.name: mart_revenue_by_nation
main.sql:
select
    c.nation_name,
    c.region_name,
    date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date) as ship_month,
    count(distinct ol.order_key)                    as order_count,
    sum(ol.net_revenue)                             as net_revenue
from "lab"."prod"."int_order_lines" ol
join "lab"."ci_main"."dim_customers" c on c.customer_key = ol.customer_key
group by 1, 2, 3
having date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date)
       >= date_trunc('month', cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-3 as bigint) * interval 1 month) as date))

main.name: rpt_customer_segments
main.sql:

    avg(lifetime_value) as avg_lifetime_value,
    sum(order_count)    as order_count
from "lab"."ci_main"."dim_customers"
group by 1, 2

pr.name: customer_features
pr.sql:
-- Customer-level order features.
-- Grain: one row per customer with at least one order up to run_date.
with customer_orders as (

    select
        customer_key,
        order_key,
        order_date,
        total_price
    from "lab"."prod"."stg_orders"
    where order_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)

)

select
    customer_key,
    count(*)            as order_count,       -- all orders, any status
    sum(total_price)    as lifetime_value,
    avg(total_price)    as avg_order_value,
    min(order_date)     as first_order_date,
    max(order_date)     as last_order_date,
    
        (date_diff('day', max(order_date)::timestamp, cast('1998-08-02' as date)::timestamp ))
     as days_since_last_order
from customer_orders
group by customer_key
